fantasy.name: Pip
fantasy.title: Arcane helper pet
fantasy.description: Pip is a cheerful little familiar who teleports between buttons and presses them for you. Upgrade speed to act more often, and intelligence to choose stronger buttons and eventually hop between worlds.

tech.name: COT-7
tech.title: Cute operations bot
tech.description: COT-7 is a tiny operations bot built to optimize your AI society. Upgrade speed to reduce the action timer, and intelligence to compare gains, wait for better purchases, and navigate between unlocked worlds.
